notes: Background screen checks now wait at least three minutes between ordinary scene changes, independently of companion talkativeness.
Direct visual questions start a fresh screen scan without waiting for the background cooldown.
Companions can request current screen evidence to answer you instead of asking you to upload a screenshot. Screen permission remains required.
Screen-access instructions stay available during long conversations, alongside your current activity and personal context.
New desktop usage records no longer count monthly token totals as individual requests. Existing historical records are preserved.
